front: When to choose a small language model
back: When latency, cost, or on-device deployment matters more than breadth of reasoning. Keyword: cheaper and faster, not smarter.
Produces vectors for retrieval and never generates text. A separate family from generative models. Keyword: vectors, not answers.
Better on multi-step problems, slower and dearer. Wasteful on simple extraction. Keyword: latency for accuracy.
Serverless bills per token and scales freely. Provisioned reserves capacity for predictable latency at fixed cost. Keyword: predictability costs money.
Tokens-per-minute quota exhausted. Retry with backoff honouring Retry-After; raise quota, spread load, or go provisioned. Keyword: quota, not outage.
Managed identity first, API keys only where nothing else is supported — a key is a bearer credential identifying nobody. Keyword: no key.
Tells you a RAG app has started answering from the model rather than from your documents. Keyword: drifting off-source.
A filter blocks in the request path. An evaluator measures against a dataset. A low score stops nothing by itself. Keyword: block vs measure.
Defend against direct and indirect prompt injection. Retrieved or supplied content is data, never instructions. Keyword: content is not a command.
Flags a response not supported by the supplied source. Detects fabrication against context, not against the world. Keyword: supported by source.
Records which sources grounded an answer, so a claim can be traced back afterwards. Keyword: which document said this.
Governs how autonomous an agent may be — constraints, tool-access limits, and approval before consequential actions. Keyword: configured, not judged.
Smaller model, shorter prompt, capped output length, cached repeated context. Keyword: tokens are the bill.
Ingest, chunk, embed, index, retrieve, generate. Retrieval quality caps everything downstream. Keyword: six stages.
Preserves sentences that would otherwise be cut in half at a chunk boundary. Keyword: don't sever the meaning.
Keyword matches terms and wins on exact identifiers. Vector matches meaning and finds paraphrases sharing no words. Keyword: term vs meaning.
Hybrid search plus semantic ranking, because each method fails where the other succeeds. Keyword: both then re-rank.
Retrieval supplies facts and keeps them current. Fine-tuning teaches form and behaviour. Never fine-tune to inject knowledge. Keyword: facts vs form.
The application executes the function, never the model. The model only emits a structured request. Keyword: model asks, app acts.
They determine whether the right tool is chosen, so they are engineering rather than documentation. Keyword: descriptions are behaviour.
Grows without limit and eventually exceeds the context window, so it is summarised or truncated. Keyword: bounded window.
Retrieve. An agent answering from a large corpus gets a search tool, not a longer prompt. Keyword: tool, not context.
When subtasks need genuinely different tools, instructions, or models. Otherwise one agent with a few tools is better. Keyword: real specialisation.
Human approval required before a consequential action. Configured explicitly, not left to the model's judgement. Keyword: gate the irreversible.
Both control randomness; adjust one, not both. Low for extraction, higher for drafting. Keyword: one dial.
A factual error. That is a grounding problem, not a sampling one. Keyword: sampling is not knowledge.
Demonstrate the required output shape far more reliably than describing it. Keyword: show, don't tell.
The same bad answer follows from a retrieval miss, a bad tool choice, or a prompt fault. Tracing attributes it. Keyword: which stage failed.
The model reviews and revises its own answer — catches a class of error and roughly doubles the cost. Keyword: pay twice.
Replaces a masked region while leaving the rest of the image intact. The mask is what makes it targeted. Keyword: masked region only.
Extends the image beyond its original frame rather than altering what is inside it. Keyword: beyond the edge.
Alt text is short and conveys purpose in context; an extended description carries figure-level detail. Keyword: length is the requirement.
Answers from the supplied image; the honest failure is refusing, not inventing. Keyword: refuse over fabricate.
Content Understanding returns named fields a system can act on; captioning returns prose for a human. Keyword: fields vs prose.
Instructions written into a picture that the model reads and follows. Mitigated by prompt shields. Keyword: text inside the image.
Watermarking, prohibited symbols, brand usage — organisation-specific, configured rather than built in. Keyword: your rules, not the platform's.

front: Foundry Tool vs generative prompt for extraction
back: Tools return typed results with confidence, deterministically and cheaply. Prompts suit bespoke or combined tasks. Keyword: typed vs flexible.
Request JSON against a named schema, keep temperature low, and validate before acting. Keyword: schema or prose.
Attaches sentiment to specific aspects — 'battery poor but screen excellent' — which the document score hides. Keyword: per aspect.
Translator is cheaper and more consistent at volume. An LLM flow wins when tone or an instruction matters. Keyword: volume vs nuance.
Prompt engineering, few-shot, retrieval, then fine-tuning last. Keyword: fine-tune last.
Trained when domain vocabulary, accents, or acoustics defeat the base model. Product names are the usual reason. Keyword: jargon.
Lower latency than transcribing and then translating separately. Keyword: one pass.
Searchable, filterable, facetable, sortable. Choosing wrong needs a rebuild — no query rewrite fixes it. Keyword: schema is a commitment.
Enriches content during indexing — OCR, entity detection, translation, chunking. Keyword: enrich on the way in.
The index generates embeddings during indexing and at query time, so the app does not have to. Keyword: built-in embedding.
A filter on a field of permitted group ids, so a user never sees results they may not open. Keyword: filter before scoring.
Adds paragraphs, tables, selection marks, and reading order, which is what keeps a table a table. Keyword: structure survives.
A low-confidence field can be routed to a human. Prose asserts everything with equal certainty. Keyword: route the doubtful.
Preserves headings and tables so chunking respects document structure instead of cutting across it. Keyword: chunk on structure.
